note: Named cameras for film.mjs (--cam <name>, or a camera key { "preset": name }; fields of the key win). Same fields as a shot's camera key: target x, z (scene metres; +x east, -z north), dist (m), az (deg; 0 = camera south of the target, north up), el (deg above the ground); plus radius (m, tiles loaded round the target: the shot's radius unless it has its own), fov (deg, only when the preset sets one; default 55) and aspect (the frame shape the preset is made for; film.mjs warns on a mismatch). home / home_v: the top-down home view of the film plan (wave G1 2.1), north up, fitting the wall, the Yangtze with the Xiaguan docks, Purple Mountain and the Southern Heights. The same numbers are in the place menu of city/index.html. How they were chosen: audit/wave_g/G1_CAM_DONE.md.

home.note: landscape: the box x -6000..6900, z -6400..6250 (river west of the docks, Meitan harbour in the north, Purple Mountain east, Yuhuatai south) with at least 7 % of the frame left on every side

home_v.note: portrait: width decides (same box in a narrow frame, 4.5 % at the sides); the five things stand between 25 % and 65 % of the height, the bottom third is left free for the Shorts interface

home_wide.note: film style, portrait (wave G4): the whole wall ring about 40 % of the height (24 to 64 %), the Yangtze with the Xiaguan docks at the left edge, Purple Mountain at the right edge, the Southern Heights at 70 to 73 %; everything between 10 and 78 % of the height. 50 % is not possible with both edges in frame: width decides (see audit/wave_g/FILMSTYLE_DONE.md)

home_city.note: film style, portrait (wave G4, re-framed 11-21): same azimuth and elevation as home_wide, closer: the whole wall ring about 55 % of the height (11 to 66 %), every gate inside the frame (3 % at the sides), the Southern Heights' centre at 74 % so that its bar and wash stay above the 78 % line; the mountain and the river are out of frame (see audit/wave_g/FILMSTYLE_DONE.md)
